CommunityApplications.Profile:
Official Community Applications templates for [nzbfast](https://github.com/nzbfast/nzbfast), a speed-focused Usenet (NZB) downloader written in Rust. Single small binary with a web dashboard, native repair and extraction, and a SABnzbd-compatible API that works with Sonarr, Radarr and friends out of the box.
This repository currently contains one template: **nzbfast**.
Support and questions: https://github.com/nzbfast/nzbfast/issues
